text.en: Pet owners widely commend the veterinarians and support nurses at Cloyne for their warmth, professionalism, and medical knowledge. Reviewers specifically praise Dr Suzanne, Ben, and Sinead for their reassuring approach during appointments, though one client noted frustration with telephone reception regarding administrative flexibility.

Clients emphasize the gentle, loving, and patient handling of both dogs and cats during checkups and treatments. Reviewers note that staff show genuine affection for visiting pets, making both young kittens and rescue animals feel relaxed and secure while receiving thorough veterinary attention.

title.en: Advice and consultations with mixed feedback

text.en: Most pet guardians value the clear communication, helpful post-treatment advice, and follow-up support provided by the veterinary team. However, feedback is mixed, as an occasional caller reported feeling dismissed over the telephone when seeking flexible arrangements, noting an emphasis on standard procedures.

q.en: How do reviewers rate the veterinary staff in Cloyne?

a.en: Clients describe the staff as caring, sympathetic, and knowledgeable, praising their compassionate approach with animals.

q.en: Can owners consult the team for pet advice?

a.en: Yes, reviewers appreciate that vets and nurses take time to answer questions and offer helpful post-visit guidance.

q.en: How does the clinic handle emergencies outside regular hours?

a.en: Emergency and out-of-hours veterinary care is coordinated through a dedicated partner emergency veterinary hospital.

q.en: What procedures are performed at the practice?

a.en: The clinic provides general health consultations, vaccinations, microchipping, routine neutering, and general surgery.
